step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows an ad-tech data ingestion and processing pipeline. First, end-user web interactions pass through Amazon CloudFront to an Amazon ECS cluster running Go microservices. The data is streamed via Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose into Amazon S3 for raw storage. Firehose also triggers AWS Lambda for aggregation. Lambda writes aggregated outputs back to Amazon S3 and Amazon DynamoDB. AWS Shield provides DDoS protection over CloudFront and S3. Internal business analysts access the aggregated analytics and dashboards via Amazon API Gateway, which pulls data from DynamoDB and S3.
